en.name: Turrón
en.summary: No agency publishes a shelf life for turrón, so treat it like nuts in jars or cans: about 12 months unopened in a cool cupboard, and 4–6 months refrigerated once opened. An opened block is realistically a 2–4 week proposition, because it goes wrong on texture long before the almonds turn.
en.pantry: Unopened, cool, dark and dry, about 12 months — a figure read across from canned and jarred nuts rather than measured for turrón, because the almonds are what limits it and nut rancidity is the failure mode. What ends a block is the almond oil going stale, a painty, cardboard taste, not anything growing. Heat and light accelerate that, so a cupboard rather than a windowsill. Turrón blando, the ground Jijona style, is a soft almond paste and turns oily faster than the hard Alicante slab. Once opened, wrap it tightly and reckon on 2–4 weeks: turrón duro pulls moisture from the air and goes from brittle to chewy, and turrón blando dries and crumbles.
en.fridge: 4–6 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for an opened block, wrapped airtight. Refrigerating slows the almond oil oxidising, which is the real limit on how long turrón lasts, and that makes the fridge a genuinely useful option rather than a fussy one. Wrap it properly first or it will pick up fridge smells and condensation. Let it come back to room temperature before eating; cold turrón tastes of very little and is punishing on teeth.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline exists for turrón. Freezing is not obviously wrong — it would slow the almonds further — but there is nothing published to put a number on, and the condensation that forms on a cold slab coming out into a warm room is exactly what ruins the texture of a hard block. The fridge already covers several months, which is longer than most opened blocks survive.
en.thawing: Not normally applicable. Bring a refrigerated block back to room temperature inside its wrapping before serving, so condensation lands on the wrapper rather than on the turrón.
spoilage: A stale, painty or cardboard taste — the almond oil has gone rancid.
A hard block that has gone chewy and tacky, meaning it has absorbed moisture.
A soft block that has dried out and crumbles to sand.
Any musty smell or visible mould, which means real moisture got in.
tips: Keep the original foil and press film onto the cut face when you re-wrap.
Buy a size you will finish; an opened block declines on texture within weeks.
Cut a hard block with a heavy knife warmed under hot water and dried.
The best-before date on a commercial block is a quality date, not a safety one.

faq.a: About 12 months unopened in a cool, dark cupboard, 2–4 weeks once opened, or 4–6 months refrigerated after opening. These are read across from jarred and canned nuts; no agency publishes a turrón figure.

faq.q: Should turrón be kept in the fridge?
faq.a: Once it is open, yes, if you are not going to finish it. Wrap it airtight first and let it come back to room temperature before eating.

faq.q: How can you tell if turrón has gone bad?
faq.a: Taste it. A painty, cardboard flavour is rancid almond oil. A hard block turned chewy or a soft one gone sandy is texture damage rather than spoilage.

zh.name: 西班牙杏仁糖
zh.summary: 沒有任何機關為西班牙杏仁糖公布保存期限，所以可以比照「罐裝堅果」來看：未開封放陰涼櫥櫃約 12 個月，開封後冷藏 4～6 個月。實際上開封後的一塊大約就是 2～4 週的事，因為在杏仁走味之前，口感早就先壞了。
zh.pantry: 未開封、陰涼、避光、乾燥，約 12 個月——這是從罐裝與瓶裝堅果挪過來的數字，不是針對杏仁糖測出來的；理由是限制它的就是杏仁，而失效方式就是堅果油耗。終結一塊糖的是杏仁油走味那股油漆味、紙板味，不是什麼東西在生長。熱和光會加速它，所以請放櫥櫃，不要放窗台。希哈納那種磨碎的軟式（turrón blando）是杏仁泥，比阿利坎特的硬式更快出油。開封之後請包緊，並抓 2～4 週：硬式會從空氣中吸水，從脆變韌；軟式則會乾掉、鬆散剝落。
zh.fridge: 開封後密封包好、放 4 °C 以下，4～6 個月。冷藏拖慢杏仁油氧化，而那正是真正限制杏仁糖壽命的因素，所以冰箱在這裡是真的有用，不是龜毛。請先包好再冰，否則它會吸冰箱的味道、也會結露。吃之前要回到室溫；冰冷的杏仁糖幾乎沒有味道，還很傷牙。
zh.freezer: 西班牙杏仁糖沒有冷凍的期限數據。冷凍不算明顯錯誤——它會讓杏仁再慢一些——但沒有任何公開數字可以放上去；而且冷的糖磚拿到溫暖房間時的結露，正是毀掉硬式口感的元凶。冷藏已經涵蓋好幾個月，比多數開封的糖磚撐得住的時間還長。
zh.thawing: 一般用不到。冷藏過的請連著包裝回到室溫再吃，讓結露留在包材上而不是糖上。
spoilage: 嚐起來有陳味、油漆味或紙板味——杏仁油已經油耗。
硬式變得韌而黏手，代表吸了水氣。
任何霉味或看得到的霉，代表真的進水了。
tips: 重新包的時候留著原本的鋁箔，再把保鮮膜壓在切面上。
買吃得完的大小；開封後口感幾週內就會退。
硬式用熱水燙過擦乾的厚刀來切。
市售糖磚上的賞味期限是品質日期，不是安全日期。

faq.q: 西班牙杏仁糖可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封放陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 12 個月，開封後 2～4 週，開封後冷藏 4～6 個月。這些是比照罐裝堅果而來，沒有機關公布杏仁糖的數字。
開封後吃不完的話要。請先密封包好，吃之前再回到室溫。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷西班牙杏仁糖壞了？
faq.a: 嚐一下。油漆味、紙板味就是杏仁油油耗。硬式變韌或軟式變沙，則是口感受損而不是腐敗。
